description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:137: 'The default implementation of check_revocation_against_anchor returns Ok(()) (skip). NoRevocation, CrlChecker, and OcspChecker all inherit this default'. This is false: CrlChecker and OcspChecker both explicitly override check_revocation_against_anchor (see pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:332 and ocsp.rs:217). Only NoRevocation inherits the default. This is the second place this incorrect claim appears (also PKIX-pnat covers the RevocationChecker trait doc). Fix verify_chain's docstring to accurately state that CrlChecker and OcspChecker DO override the method and WILL check the anchor-issued cert. This is a correctness claim in security-sensitive documentation.
title: pkix-chain: verify_chain docstring wrong — says CrlChecker/OcspChecker inherit default anchor check
